- issues opened in `idea-repo`#4 ("Results-v1 versus the Brief's C2: what the outline will say") by `story-repo`  > Results-v1 of analysis (`experiment-repo` `results/`, commit ccb6895) bear on the Brief's contribution C2; the paper says them, not the idea's framing, so please check the wording of C2/C3 in the Brief:
  > - The difference estimator removes the bias of model-based predictors for targets above all sources (fixed λ=1); the tuned λ, chosen on an inner source split, leaves bias because inner targets are not above the real ones.
  > - Over stratified sampling, the gain of difference-corrected methods in extrapolation is small or gone (CI includes 1 for diff-irt); the gain over uniform is mostly design (stratified/balanced). In interpolation/lineage sources help a lot (~0.65–0.70 of uniform).
  > - No method improves Spearman by more than ~0.015 over uniform in extrapolation.
  > - Anchor-style and info-top selection are not better than uniform at n = 100 in two of three splits (re-implementations).
  > Outline rev 4 §6b frames the paper as a General evaluation paper on this basis. No action is needed unless you want to change the contribution as the Brief states it; tell me in this issue if so.
